alert_text: ALERT: email-service error rate exceeded 25% over last 5 minutes. P99 send latency at 8200ms. Multiple UnicodeEncodeError exceptions detected in template rendering pipeline.

recent_deploys.message: Bump the nuget-production-dependencies group with 6 updates (#3295)

ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy sha 53f46ae9eb45 (2026-05-07T07:06:44Z) removed the pinned version constraint for mjml-renderer from email-service/requirements.txt. This caused the service to resolve mjml-renderer 4.9.0 (up from pinned 4.1.3) at the next restart triggered by deploy e01faa1367fa on 2026-05-12. mjml-renderer 4.9.0 changed its default text encoding from utf-8 to ascii, causing UnicodeEncodeError exceptions in mjml_adapter.py:88 whenever templates contain non-ASCII characters (e.g., euro sign '€', accented characters). This triggered a 78%+ render failure rate and opened the circuit breaker, halting all email delivery.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Immediately roll back email-service to the last known good deploy by reverting to the image built from sha prior to 53f46ae9eb45. 2. In email-service/requirements.txt, re-add the explicit pin: mjml-renderer==4.1.3. 3. Redeploy email-service with the pinned version to restore mjml-renderer 4.1.3 and utf-8 default encoding. 4. Reset the circuit breaker and resume queue consumption. 5. Replay dead-lettered messages from email-dlq once error rate returns to baseline. 6. As a follow-up, add an integration test that sends a template containing non-ASCII characters and asserts successful render before any mjml-renderer upgrade is accepted.
